title: Fault acceptance
description: A customer's acceptance of a provider's showing that a failed segment's failure was its fault (REQ-ORD-11): the body of its own signed statement, of shape urn:rutent:core-internal:fault-acceptance, as an acceptance's yes is its reserve's. It names the showing it accepts, by the showing's transaction and commitment, and the fault it accepts, the customer's own. Its stated entry is about the order, the segment and the showing's transaction.

transaction.description: The transaction the provider's showing, its failed result, is about.

showing.description: The commitment the showing's stated entry names it by.

fault.description: The fault accepted, as the showing names it: the customer's own where the customer accepts it.
